components.css: .ds-button-primary{font-family:Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:20px;border-radius:14px;transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:40px;padding:8px 16px;font-weight:500;border:none;background:var(--primary, hsl(221 94% 48%));color:var(--primary-foreground, hsl(0 0% 100%));cursor:pointer} .ds-button-primary:hover{background:var(--primary-hover, hsl(221 94% 41%))} .ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary, hsl(221 94% 48%));outline-offset:3px;} .ds-button-primary:active{background:var(--primary-hover, hsl(221 94% 41%))} .ds-button-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: Text field
components.description: Visible label, associated hint and the shared field treatment.

components.css: .ds-field-label{display:block;font-family:Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:6px;color:var(--foreground, hsl(240 8% 10%))}.ds-input{font-family:Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:20px;border-radius:14px;transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);min-height:40px;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--input, hsl(240 5% 81%));background:var(--card, hsl(0 0% 100%));color:var(--foreground, hsl(240 8% 10%));caret-color:var(--primary, hsl(221 94% 48%))}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted-foreground, hsl(240 4% 43%));opacity:1}.ds-input:hover{border-color:var(--input, hsl(240 5% 81%))}.ds-input:focus{border-color:var(--primary, hsl(221 94% 48%))}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary, hsl(221 94% 48%));outline-offset:3px;}.ds-input:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}.ds-field-hint{font-family:Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;font-size:12px;line-height:16px;color:var(--muted-foreground, hsl(240 4% 43%));margin:8px 0 0}

components.name: Active navigation

narrative.northStar: The Verity family, specialized for rentals
narrative.overview:
Rental App shares Verity’s pearl workspace, graphite text, Inter typography and blue actions. Its content and navigation center on properties, tenancies, rent, deposits, mortgages and costs. This records the user-selected family resemblance already implemented in the source; it does not introduce a new visual direction.

The desktop workspace is calm and compact: broad page margins, quiet dividers and clearly grouped values. Existing responsive compositions remain intact. Functional color explains actions or status; rental information carries the page.
keyCharacteristics: Pearl workspace with white content surfaces and graphite text.
Inter with restrained headings and aligned financial numerals.
Blue actions, visible keyboard focus and explicit status labels.
Grouped financial values within one parent panel.
dos: Do use the shared semantic colors and existing components for new screens.
Do keep rental labels and billing scope visible beside financial values.
Do associate each field label with its control and preserve hints, error messages and pending states.
Do use one parent panel for related subtotal values and retain existing responsive breakpoints.
Do keep hypothetical mortgage scenarios visibly separate from saved loan terms.
donts: Do not introduce decorative gradients or an unrelated brand palette.
Do not nest a new card around each subtotal inside an existing panel.
Do not use color as the only indicator of status.
Do not redesign the mobile composition as part of a desktop styling pass.
Do not imply bank reconciliation, live production data or connector success through a visual state without evidence.
